description: Géofer : Données de potentiel territorial des gares ferroviaires is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cerema. Provision of the data used by Geofer, a cartographic platform dedicated to the Cerema railway. This dataset contains both the data related to each station present in Geofer, with the associated information such as attendance, the railway offer serving the station, but above all the information useful for estimating its potential: the population, salaried jobs ... Coverage: Cerema. The portal shows the English title as "Geofer: Data on the territorial potential of railway stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cerema. Its keywords include mobilite-transport, ferroviaire, transports-infrastructure-ferroviaire, gares-de-voyageurs, mobilite, mobilite-et-transports. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
